Mrs. Fisher: Nice yellow perch you caught there, but there’s not much point to a panfish that doesn’t fit a pan. 
Mrs. Fisher: Just remember to wear gloves when fishing for them, they have several sharp spines in their dorsal fins, pelvic fins, anal fins and at the end of each gill cover. 
Mrs. Fisher: These spines are small, but sharp enough to pierce human skin with ease.
You: Got it.
